groups.note: Where the vehicles are kept — often within the hour
groups.line: Self drive car at Nagercoil Railway Station, at Nagercoil Town Railway Station and at Vadasery Bus Stand — handed over on the platform or at the stand, whichever you arrive at.

groups.note: To your hotel, the station or the ferry road
groups.line: Self drive car at Kanyakumari Railway Station, or brought to your hotel near the beach. Bikes the same, if a two-wheeler suits the day better.

groups.note: Delivered the same way, a little further out
groups.line: Self drive car at Marthandam, at Muttom and at Thuckalay, and self drive cars and bikes at Parvathipuram.
